reviews.t: Pros: - Packaging: high-quality, there is a ...
reviews.x: Pros: - Packaging: high-quality, there is a left/right turn plastic cover that hides the cushion - Texture: no smell, light feel  Cons: - Dark, not the same neutral shade as the KLAIRS BB in the tube - This has a pink/orange undertone - If you have tried the Mizon Snail BB, Dr. Jart Water BB, Skin79 Hot Pink, this will be too dark for you. - Sticky, but clings to dry patches? And wears off throughout the day in patches, even with a powder on top!

reviews.t: Not impressive
reviews.x: Not impressive at all. Texture, smell, packaging, application were all ok, but lasting power is non-existent. Not even slightly resistant to any sort of humidity. Leaves nasty, flakey patches as it fades off my face. Half way through the day sitting in the office my face already looks like a hot mess. And I don't have particular oily or dry skin. Not practical at all.

reviews.t: Love the bb cushion, so cute

reviews.t: Cute and functional!
reviews.x: I'm an NC15 in MAC shades and this product matches me perfectly. It's incredibly sheer so it's not recommended if you want full-coverage. After using liquid foundations for so long, I forgot how easy and quick it was to use a bb cushion! I just pat this all over my face, no primer, and it lasts all day. Very natural finish, not too dewy or matte. Incredibly cute packaging sucked me in, but Klairs is a good Korean brand! :)

reviews.t: Sad that it won't fit tanned asian skin tones
reviews.x: It's very light for tanned asian skin. As someone in the army with a pretty dark tan, this color was way too light for me. It would've fit my skin before I was tan though. Love the character and the cushion! Refilable too! And it locks to keep the cushion moist so it's hygienic.

reviews.t: So a love hate relationship here

reviews.t: Loooove it!!!!

reviews.t: Excellent product that doesn't break your wallet!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the packaging cute and high-quality, though some received opened or damaged packages with scratched mirrors.
The shade runs very light and is best suited to fair skin, with several reviewers finding it too dark or too light for their skin tone.
Reviewers describe a natural, light-to-medium finish that can look soft and velvety, though some find it sheer or ghostly pale.
Lasting power is a common complaint, with the product wearing off easily and leaving flakey patches.
Some reviewers report skin irritation from the product.
